To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

decision trees are the most suitable prediction model for compressive strength, which is a very important parameter of concrete, and that the most important parameter for compressive strength is the amount of cement used in concrete.

the most successful model is obtained with the combination of the decision tree and genetic algorithm, and the most important parameters for concrete compressive strength prediction are water-cement ratio, age of concrete, and compressive strength of concrete.
the most accurate prediction model was obtained by using hybrid model with 5 different machine learning methods, and this prediction model achieved 0.98 accuracy and 0.98 precision.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new hybrid models for prediction of compressive strength in concrete.
the prediction of concrete compressive strengths with the help of artificial intelligence and machine-learning techniques, and it can be used for future researches.
the use of machine learning methods in predicting concrete compressive strength.

the prediction model based on hybrid decision trees method is more successful in predicting concrete compressive strength.
the decision trees based on machine learning methods are the most successful methods in prediction applications of concrete strength values.
the hybrid prediction model which is composed of artificial intelligence and machine-learning methods, is a more successful and accurate prediction model for concrete compressive strength.

the prediction model, which is based on decision trees, is more accurate than other prediction methods.
prediction of concrete compressive strengths can be performed successfully with the use of advanced machine learning methods.
